In [[algebraic geometry]], given a projective algebraic [[hypersurface]] <math>C</math> described by the homogeneous equation

: <math>f(x_0,x_1,x_2,\dots) = 0</math>

and a point

: <math>a = (a_0:a_1:a_2: \cdots)</math>

its '''polar hypersurface''' <math>P_a(C)</math> is the hypersurface

: <math>a_0 f_0 + a_1 f_1 + a_2 f_2+\cdots = 0, \, </math>

where <math>f_i</math> are the partial derivatives of <math>f</math>.

The intersection of <math>C</math> and <math>P_a(C)</math> is the  set of points <math>p</math> such that the tangent at <math>p</math> to <math>C</math> meets <math>a</math>.
